name: EPIC 212226264

text.card: A red giant 2,158 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 16, give 1.20 solar masses and 7.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,768 K at its surface.
